name: msvc_c89
description: Microsoft Visual C/C++ compiler in C mode
compile_command: cl /nologo /TC /W4 /O2 /DFAX_WITH_PNG /DFAX_WITH_JPEG /DFAX_WITH_TIFF /I<codec-include> fax_core.c fax_engine.c fax_g3.c fax_image.c fax_tables.c fax_thread.c fax_default_params.c fax_engine_test.c /link <static-codec-libraries> /OUT:fax_engine_test.exe
notes: Use the Visual Studio Developer Command Prompt so cl.exe and the standard headers are on PATH.
The generated core uses a C89-compatible subset; /TC selects C compilation.
Compiler warning policy can be tightened after the first successful build.
The engine performs no heap allocation; the host supplies its workspace. The convenience test driver uses malloc and standard file I/O.
The optimizer and image transforms use C math functions (pow, exp, sqrt, floor, fmod); ensure the toolchain links its math runtime.
The image adapter calls libpng, libjpeg-turbo and libtiff in-process. Configure include/library paths for the versions installed in the Developer Command Prompt.
Prefer static codec libraries when distributing a single executable. No ImageMagick/ffmpeg-style converter process or temporary PGM is used.
Omit codec defines and fax_image codec link libraries to retain built-in PGM/BMP input only.
endianness: native compiler target; no byte-order assumptions in the core
